input.question: Why have some South Africans been attacking migrants recently?
input.ground_truth: The king of one of the more sizable South African ethnic groups stated in an interview that foreigners were taking jobs and that they needed to "go home". He's since said the newspapers falsified this quote, but many people who recognize him as a leader have acted on this statement to try and force migrants from other African nations to leave. This has involved bloodshed more and more often as the days have passed. [Slightly more information](_URL_0_)
